_note: Descriptions for low-level instructions and script functions. Key = name.
Window_ShowText: opens a debug window and displays text, max 250 characters
Terrain_GetHeight: first parameter is output height, second is input position
GetAutofinance: first param rub, second param usd; 0, 0 - build form resources
Tools_GetActualTool:
get identifier of the actual cursor tool;

char[0] == 0 if no tool is selected or if array is shorter than tools identifier; best to use array length 64
Tools_GetActualToolBuildingType: get building type, -1 if no tool, or no building type
Tools_GetActualToolBuildingSubType: get building subtype, -1 if no tool, or no building type
ScreenMark_Create: create a small box in the world (can serve as a marker)
Script_StartNew: starts a new script, script has to be in the same directory as current script
Script_Exists: check if script with a name exists, input name, output char 0/1
Script_SetUpdateFrequency: how many script instructions are executed per second <1, 50000>
Script_GetUpdateFrequency: how many script instructions are executed per second <1, 50000>
Script_ResetUpdateTime: in case of in-game performance heavy functions, you can use this instruction to reset the update time and execute these functions only once per frame
Script_SetContinuous:
scripts are by default not continuous, meaning they are deleted once they reach the last line

by setting this to 1, your script will reset after it reaches the last line
Script_ExecutionEntireAtOnce:
similar to Script_SetContinuous, if this is set to 1 script will be reset after the last line

however, if this is set to 1, the entire script will be executed in 1 frame

be careful with this instruction as it can freeze the game; see freeze.txt example for more
Script_ExecutionEntireAtOnceCD:
if Script_ExecutionEntireAtOnce is set to 1, entire script will be executed after every x seconds

default value for this is 1 second
Script_GetTime:
get current script time in seconds

get amount of seconds since this script was launched, ignore game pause and game speed
Script_GetGameTime:
get current script time in seconds

get amount of seconds since this script was launched, accounts for game pause and game speed
Script_EnterCriticalSection:
all instructions inside of critical section are executed in a single frame

be careful with this instruction as it can freeze the game; see freeze.txt example for more
Script_LeaveCriticalSection:
all instructions inside of critical section are executed in a single frame

be careful with this instruction as it can freeze the game; see freeze.txt example for more
Script_Sleep:
pause script execution for x seconds

does nothing if Script_ExecutionEntireAtOnce is 1 or if inside Script_EnterCriticalSection
Log_PrintWarning:
Add a warning to "log.html"

void instructions can use only direct variables, meaning you can not use arrays or struct members
Log_PrintError:
Add an error to "log.html"

void instructions can use only direct variables, meaning you can not use arrays or struct members
Objective_AddRequirement:
input: identifier, required value, image file name

no value - display amount only; >0 - distplay x/x; <0 - x.f/x.f; <0.01 - no numbers, only image
Objective_UpdateRequirementToTarget: input: identifier, index; set value to required value
Objectives_ClearAll:
deletes all objectives

note: objectives all global and shared between all scritps

if you have multiple scritps running this will delete objectives for all of them
Date_GetCurrentDate_D365Y: get date as day of year 0-364 and year
Date_GetCurrentDate_DMY: get date as day, month, year
Date_SetCurrentDate_D365Y: set date as day of year 0-364 and year
Notification_CreateNewLangIDPic:

Notification_CreateNewStringPic: input: caption, text, image file name, position in world
